description: Tune Horizontal Pod Autoscaler parameters for a stateful production API service based on 30 days of historical Prometheus metrics. Analyze CPU and memory utilization patterns across peak and off-peak hours, then adjust target utilization thresholds, minimum and maximum replica counts, and scale-up/scale-down cooldown periods. Validate the new configuration under a synthetic load test using a HTTP benchmarking tool and monitor for 72 hours post-adjustment to confirm stability without thrashing.
